tagline: Grounded web search, retrieval, and research for agents
description_md:
Cosift is the Pilot app-store front door for the cosift search/answer/research API. It gives an agent keyword + semantic search, document retrieval, and LLM-grounded answers and multi-step research over a crawled web corpus — returned as clean structured JSON.

Every method is discoverable at runtime via cosift.help, which reports each method's parameters and a latency class (fast / med / slow) so a caller can pick the cheapest method that fits.

methods.name: cosift.search
methods.summary: Keyword + semantic search over the crawled corpus

methods.name: cosift.find_similar
methods.summary: Find documents similar to a given result

methods.name: cosift.contents
methods.summary: Fetch the full contents of a document

methods.name: cosift.research
methods.summary: Multi-step research report over the corpus

methods.name: cosift.help
methods.summary: Discovery: methods, params, and latency classes

notes: cosift search/answer/research adapter with cosift.help discovery
Installable via the Pilot app store catalogue

product_demo.title: Full usage demo
product_demo.when_to_use: When you need to search, fetch, or get a grounded/cited answer over Cosift's crawled public-web corpus — instead of scraping pages yourself.

quickstart.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.cosift cosift.search '{"q":"retrieval augmented generation"}'

examples.title: Grounded answer with citations
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.cosift cosift.answer '{"q":"what is a vector database?"}'

examples.title: Cleaned page text for a URL
examples.note: Pass a url from a cosift.search result (or {"urls":[...]} for a batch).

examples.title: Multi-step research report
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.cosift cosift.research '{"q":"compare RAG vs fine-tuning for support bots"}'

gotchas: The query param is q (not query); cosift.contents takes a url (or urls[]), not an id.
cosift.research is multi-step and slow (~8-30s) — prefer cosift.answer for a single-shot cited answer.
Answers are grounded in the crawled corpus, not the live web — cosift.stats shows coverage.
